infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: BeSafe uses your location to verify rides and share your trip with loved ones for safety.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: BeSafe tracks your rides in real-time so we can alert authorities and your emergency contacts if you activate SOS.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: BeSafe needs camera access to scan vehicle QR codes and verify your driver.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: BeSafe needs access to save your vehicle QR code for offline display.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Save your BeSafe verified vehicle QR code to your photos.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow BeSafe to use your location for ride verification and safety tracking.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow BeSafe to access your camera to scan vehicle QR codes.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow BeSafe to save your vehicle QR code.
plugins.savePhotosPermission: Allow BeSafe to save your vehicle QR code.
